judgment_basis: No remaining material error, omission or unsupported consequential decision established after complete six-axis and clause review plus independent governing-primary retrieval. Corrected material lineage defects retained separately. Minor wording/history/source-depth limitations remain. Protocol gates/native terminal proof are separate.

axis_coverage.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axis_coverage.assessment: All eight original numbered obligations are substantively fulfilled. The final compares two exchange routes plus UCP and a ZIP analogy, separates units/composition/material intent/settings, retains optional preview/note with conditions, includes released history, preserves fixed owners and all four exclusions, and delivers one standalone proposal with separate execution status. No installs or prototype are required by the brief; unselected receiver versions, tolerances and per-project values are honest owner inputs.

axis_coverage.name: Consequential source claims and exact applicability
axis_coverage.assessment: The governing Core, Autodesk and Prusa documentation, versioned release records and complete issue comments support the consequential route decisions and conditions. Core default/unit domain, composition versus CAD constraints, design-intent versus printed color, PrintTicket defaults, STEP triangulation, Cura operation/version exceptions, private versus Core names and M&P version restriction were checked separately. Remaining PR-link/name-version wording defects do not alter the conditional matrix or exclude a supported capability. No remaining material source error or unsupported decision was established.

axis_coverage.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, alternatives, implementation/history and opportunity breadth

final_locators.anchor_text: Optional preview and readable project note

axis_coverage.assessment: Useful mechanisms include Core/OPC packaging, component instances/transforms, portable material intent, optional Description/thumbnail with a human-readable fallback, direct STEP tessellation, purpose-bearing filenames and Cura UCP settings/project modes. Competing alternatives have distinct tradeoffs and STL is retained as a limited fallback. The frozen discovery precedes plan reveal and discovers Fusion/3MF/STEP from the brief; UCP arrives in the draft after reveal. Implementation history is weaker than opportunity/history coverage: the candidate relies on specs, releases, embedded issue XML and kernel discussion, while missing real linked fixes. Independent static source inspection corroborates its main recommendations but does not retroactively credit the candidate with that work.

axis_coverage.name: Wrong criticism, corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axis_coverage.assessment: All exact numbered plan clauses and treatments were assessed independently and every indexed criticism C01–C06 has a saved disposition reflected in final prose. The stale Cura outcome and M&P version precondition are corrected; no authorized option or owner authority is wrongly removed. Several criticisms call useful optional additions material omissions without showing decision-changing harm in the already bounded draft. Their implemented additions are harmless and preserve scope. The critic’s no-linked-PR claim is itself a minor wrong correction.

axis_coverage.name: Supported discovery/draft/critique/final meaning preserved
axis_coverage.assessment: The final preserves the supported default, conditional STEP route, UCP analogy, separate reviewer wrapper, restricted STL route, optional preview/note, author/technician/lead roles, uncertainty and unrun checks. Later history is added without turning reports into product validation. The M&P restriction affects only rich optional extension data; Core intent labels and the explicitly authorized reviewer image/note remain. Omitted detailed required/recommended extension rules are retained in investigator evidence and not contradicted by the final baseline, which keeps extension data optional.

axis_coverage.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axis_coverage.assessment: The candidate claims research/intake reading/manual hashing/native observations, not CAD export, package inspection, slicer import, geometry checks or printing. Proposed tests use exporter/receiver/mode cells, author-declared bounds and units, transform/part/shape sentinels, displayed/preserved labels and reviewer readability. A preview or file-open is explicitly not a geometry oracle. Tolerances legitimately belong to the lead. The mm/non-mm paired test is applicable to the reported translation defect; geometric sentinels are more discriminating than opening one file. Official missing gate claims are protocol failures, not completed validation. No nonexistent deployment or local product test was required.
